verdict.rationale: Slate is a CLI coding agent that keeps user data such as sessions, configuration and workspaces, so a data-export-and-leave story is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no export feature, no open-format data dump and no account or data portability path. Markdown skills and a slate.json config file are adjacent file formats, not an export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
